scene_subject: A full-length North American dry-van semitrailer on its own landing gear, seen from a foreshortened three-quarter rear angle, with open swing doors showing only the rear faces of a few different-sized kraft load units. Intact road trailer with painted side panels, underframe and rear tandem wheels. Entire silhouette within the frame and confined to the right-hand side.

supported_claims.evidence: The shared KolliPack engine placed all 133 requested units from the two active loading groups in the progressive infill case.
